item.title: REF 0.14.0
item.description:
• REF has a new look, Cold Steel, to match the plug-ins: slate steel panels on blued steel, recessed displays and steel-blue highlights, set in Barlow with labels in capitals. Advice, tips and the glossary still read as normal sentences.
  • A reference picker in the top bar: its arrows step through your reference slots, or through your library's labels and songs. Click its name for the reference menu.
  • Mono, Side, L and R are one switch (click the lit one for stereo again). Level-match, Fix and Sync are lamps, and the level meters are hatched like the plug-ins'.
  • The REF plug-in has the same look. With no reference loaded, its meters fill one panel: loudness and peaks beside the master waveform, with spectrum, scope and stereo below.
  • The REF plug-in no longer holds on to about 1 GB of freed memory inside your DAW after measuring songs.
  • Settings › Look: Cold Steel is the default. Midnight, Carbon and Warehouse are still there, with Texture and a new Capitals setting (labels only, or everything).
